# Mahadev Mechanical Car Garage

> Complete Car Care Under One Roof in Gohana, Haryana. Modern multi-brand car workshop specializing in dealer-standard mechanical service, Japanese-tech engine decarbonization, automated AC servicing, car detailing, and OBD-II computerized diagnostics.

## Business Overview
- **Name**: Mahadev Mechanical Car Garage
- **Location**: Near JK Garden, Gohana–Panipat Road, Gohana, Haryana 131301, India
- **Phone**: +91 82956 69463
- **WhatsApp**: +91 82956 69463
- **Website**: https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/
- **Established**: 2018
- **Operating Hours**:
  - Monday – Saturday: 09:00 AM – 07:30 PM
  - Sunday: 10:00 AM – 04:00 PM (By Appointment Only)

## Key Workshop Services
- [General Car Service](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): Synthetic engine oil change, OEM oil/air filters, fluid top-ups, spark plugs, and comprehensive 40-point safety inspection.
- [Engine Carbon Cleaning](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): In-chassis hydrogen decarbonization using Japanese-tech machinery. Cleans combustion chambers and intake valves without dismantling the engine.
- [Automated AC Servicing](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): Automated refrigerant recovery, deep vacuum leak testing, compressor oil top-up, and precise R134a gas recharge.
- [Car Detailing & Foam Wash](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): Dual-action compounding, swirl and scratch correction, high-temp interior steam sanitization, and pH-neutral snow foam wash.
- [OBD-II Computer Diagnostics](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): ECU scanning, live sensor diagnostics, check engine light analysis, and alternator/battery testing.
- [Brakes & Suspension](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): Disc rotor truing, caliper overhaul, OEM brake pads, hydraulic bleeding, and shock absorber replacement.
- [Denting & Paint Correction](https://mahadev-mechanical-car-garage.vercel.app/#services): Panel beating, dent puller repair, precision color matching, and heated high-gloss clear coat.

## Supported Vehicle Brands
Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, Tata Motors, Mahindra, Toyota, Honda, Kia, Ford, Renault, Nissan, Skoda, Volkswagen, and other multi-brand passenger vehicles.
